environment: LOCAL production build on http://127.0.0.1:3017, Chromium desktop/mobile and WebKit mobile

latestResults.note: Latest result per file/title/browser, combining the full regression run and focused correction runs; not one monolithic 150-case run.

findingsResolved.issue: New hero handoff must retain random palette selection
findingsResolved.change: Use the existing randomPalette selector for both landing lines.

findingsResolved.issue: Three prior assertions expected a hero wipe band and two mobile assertions expected a missing path attribute
findingsResolved.change: Assert incoming handoff plus gradient, preserve independent band-color assertion on unchanged philosophy heading, and assert an empty invisible mobile trail. No test skips or threshold relaxation.

findingsResolved.issue: Deferred font readiness could restart docking after OS reduced-motion had dismissed the effect
findingsResolved.reproduction: LOCAL browser fault injection: defer document.fonts.ready, change reduced motion, release font promise; observed intro states done -> docking before fix.
findingsResolved.change: Ignore pending promises from disposed opening effects.
findingsResolved.verification: New regression passed in all three browser projects; ordinary opening and dismissal scenarios rechecked.

scopeNotes: Company information and illustrative metrics notices retained.
Unconfigured contact submission and unpublished privacy policy remain truthful.
No completed hero video available; adopted animated key visual retained.
warnings: Existing Next build warning: missing LINE Seed JP fallback font metadata.
